execution.method: Function-level executable reproduction using the exact inspected _rank/_coalesce_key/_preferred_coalesced control logic from the pinned F2 source and an ObserveIntent-shaped immutable test value. The connector source was not mounted as an importable repository checkout, so this receipt does not claim full-module or target-host execution.

test_cases.setup: Same source/heads/atoms/ROI/remote/VLM fields, same generation=1, same priority=900000, same work=2 and same permission digest. strict intent requires freshness_ns=10000000 and expires=1100000000; loose intent requires freshness_ns=500000000 and expires=2000000000.
test_cases.meaning: Coalescing discards the stricter/fresher earlier-deadline obligation even though the scheduler's ordinary rank would prefer it.

test_cases.setup: Same coalesce target fields and equal generation/priority/work/freshness, but permission_snapshot_sha256 differs; the later-expiry request carries a different digest.
test_cases.meaning: Permission epoch/digest is erased by equivalence. Dispatch-time validation still prevents authority escalation, but useful valid work can be lost if the retained request later fails validation.

falsified_claim_scope.claim: Same target/coalesce-key ObserveIntents can be safely latest-wins coalesced without considering freshness, deadline or permission binding.
not_falsified: WP710 bounded queue behavior in general

hypothesis_update.statement: WP710 needs semantic-obligation dominance or conservative equivalence before latest-wins coalescing can be considered correct.
preferred_minimal_repair_order: First write canonical regression tests that reproduce E3-C1 and E3-C2 against the real module.
Then choose either conservative equivalence (include freshness/expiry/permission digest) or a pure dominance/merge relation preserving strictest compatible obligations.
Retest admission fairness and drop-diagnostic ordering separately; do not bundle unrelated complexity into the same repair.

counterhypothesis.statement: An upstream contract could guarantee that later same-key intents subsume earlier obligations, making the observed source behavior safe in practice.
counterhypothesis.falsifier_or_rescue: Provide an executable/contract-bound upstream invariant proving monotonic subsumption of freshness, expiry and permission semantics across same-key generations. Absent that, fail closed on semantic conflation.

handoff.required_test: Two same-target intents with stricter-vs-looser freshness/deadline must not silently retain only the looser obligation; differing permission digests must not be conflated in a way that destroys still-valid work.

write_race_note: First append-only receipt write attempt returned HTTP 409 because main advanced concurrently. This is coordination/head-race evidence only, not a product/scientific failure; no partial receipt was claimed from that attempt.
